title: Without Delete, a user can still edit an untracked part's price and bins
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-UNTRKEDIT) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-UNTRKEDIT-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-UNTRK-01) is untracked at {Location-A}, with Sell Price $15.00 and 4 in {Bin-A}.
  • The new description {Description-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NO DELETE UNTRACKED EDITED) is not used by any part.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-B}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Change Sell Price to 18.00.
  3. Change the Quantity of {Bin-A} to 6.
  4. Replace the Description with {Description-B}.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Read the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: The dialog closes and saves with no access error: editing other fields of an untracked part needs the same access as on a tracked part.
  • Step 6: The row shows {Description-B}, Sell Price $18.00, bin "{Bin-A} | 6" and still "Not Tracked"; the tracking state did not change.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-N1a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.6 and create-note-6 (now worded as S8-N1a), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment, Chris Ward, 8 Oct 2026 (the narrower reading of S8-N1, new S8-N1a). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-N1a: “Editing any other field of a part that is already untracked, such as its price, bins or description, needs the same access as editing a tracked part today.”
